description: This file contains helper functions and builder types for constructing RBAC policy rules and cluster role bindings in Kubernetes, with validation logic included.

classes.name: PolicyRuleBuilder
classes.description: A builder for constructing and validating rbacv1beta1.PolicyRule objects.

classes.name: ClusterRoleBindingBuilder
classes.description: A builder for constructing and validating rbacv1beta1.ClusterRoleBinding objects.

methods.name: Groups
methods.description: Adds groups to the PolicyRule or Subject list.

methods.name: Names
methods.description: Adds resource names to the PolicyRule.

methods.name: URLs
methods.description: Adds non-resource URLs to the PolicyRule.

methods.name: RuleOrDie
methods.description: Returns the constructed PolicyRule or panics if invalid.

methods.name: Rule
methods.description: Validates and returns the constructed PolicyRule.

methods.name: BindingOrDie
methods.description: Returns the constructed ClusterRoleBinding or panics if invalid.

methods.name: Binding
methods.description: Validates and returns the constructed ClusterRoleBinding.

methods.name: SAs
methods.description: Adds service accounts to the ClusterRoleBinding subjects.
